<summary>
Turn 1: Located the provided workbook /root/test-supply.xlsx.

Turn 2: Loaded the workbook and inspected the first rows of each sheet. Sheets present: Production, Investment, CFC data, PWT, WEO_Data. Observed: Investment sheet already contains 2026–2033 “Project Investment (Deflated)” values in column C. CFC data sheet has years 1996–(at least) 2009 shown with Column C (CFC), Column D (Capital Stock), Column E (Depreciation rate) empty. PWT sheet currently only has columns A “year” and B “rnna” with years starting 1990 and rnna empty. WEO_Data sheet contains metadata rows (country Georgia; subject codes NGDP_R and NGDP_RPCH) and a year column from 2000 onward, but the data cells for level and growth are empty.

Turn 3: Confirmed PWT sheet only has header “year”, “rnna” (no other variables visible). In Production sheet, confirmed the HP filter headers at row 5: K (col D), Real GDP (E), LnK (F), LnY (G), LnZ (K), LnZ_HP (L), second-order difference (M), LnA-Trend check (N). Also confirmed a second table starting row 35 with headers: K/Y (D), K (E), Y (F), LnZ trend (G), Ystar_base (H), Investment (I), ΔK (J), K_With (K), Ystar_with (L), Uplift (M), Projected GDP (N), Projected GDP Growth (O), Baseline GDP Growth (P). Rows for years 2002–2041 are present but empty.

Turn 4: Checked WEO_Data year coverage: years 2000–2043 are already laid out (rows 8–51) but the GDP level and growth columns are blank. The sheet itself is extremely large (max_row ~1,032,228), suggesting it may contain a large unused template region beyond the visible years.

Turn 5–6: Inspected the HP filter area in Production. Objective cell P5 is currently blank; no explicit “lambda”/HP parameter cell found. HP filter columns (LnZ, LnZ_HP, etc.) are present but not populated yet.

Turn 7–8: Confirmed Production projection table covers 2002–2041 (40 years) with the table headers across columns D–P as described above.

Turn 9: Attempted to use Python “requests” to fetch IMF DataMapper API but failed because the requests module is not installed (ModuleNotFoundError).

Turn 10–14: Switched to curl/urllib to query IMF DataMapper API. Found that NGDP_RPCH (Real GDP growth) for GEO returns valid values (1995–2031 available; 2027–2031 show 5). However, NGDP_R (Real GDP level) endpoints returned only country/group/region metadata and no values (also tested USA/SDN with same result). Listed DataMapper indicators (132 total) confirming NGDP_RPCH exists. Conclusion so far: DataMapper API provides growth but not NGDP_R level via the same method.

Turn 15: Attempted IMF SDMX JSON endpoint for WEO CompactData (WEO/A.GEO.NGDP_R...) for 2000–2027, but the response returned empty (no JSON content captured), so real GDP level data still not obtained.

No evidence in this window that the workbook was modified/saved yet; activities were inspection and API probing only. No Playwright browser usage yet.</summary>
